name: hackathon-sbp
description: Rankings de crédito · Hackathon SBP 2026: scripts para correr server y client juntos

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "node scripts/con-env.mjs dev" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
